Lord '''Tagriss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who at one point during the [[Galactic War]] pledged his loyalty to the [[Dread Masters]]. For his new masters, Tagriss guided the [[Dread Host|Dread Guard]] in a [[Raid on the Arcanum|raid]] to the [[Arcanum]], a Sith secret deposit of prohibited lore, and here took many terrible objects, among them the [[Seeds of Rage]] that Tagriss used to create fear on many planets. However, he was pursued by task forces from both the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and in the end one of them [[Confrontation on Ilum|defeated]] him in a base on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].
